Nothing has been compiled, as you asked. `pulsar-metadata`, `pulsar-common` and `pulsar-broker-common` needed no changes: their `getLedgerId()` calls are on `MessageIdAdv` or protobuf types.

I also reverted three calls on `Entry` receivers that my first pass had renamed by mistake (in `ManagedCursorImpl`).

The `entry.getLedgerId()` calls in `MLTransactionLogImpl` look like `Entry` calls and are probably fine.
- **Not checked:** I only searched `src/main`. Other modules' `src/main` (`pulsar-client`, `tiered-storage`, `microbench` and others) and all `src/test` code may also call the old name.
